source_title: Shield HealthCare Expands Access to Medical Supplies for Eligible Astiva Health Members in Southern California
source_excerpt:
LOS ANGELES, Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Shield HealthCare is now fully contracted with Astiva Health in Southern California, expanding access to covered medical supplies and services for eligible members. Through the new agreement, members whose plans include covered supplies can obtain them through Shield HealthCare, subject to individual plan benefits and coverage requirements.
Shield HealthCare provides medical supplies to patients at home and offers billing support to help customers navigate insurance requirements and access eligible products. The agreement broadens access to these services for eligible Astiva Health members.
Astiva Health offers Medicare HMO and Chronic Condition Special Needs Plans (C-SNPs) for eligible Medicare beneficiaries, including those with qualifying chronic conditions.
"We are excited to welcome Astiva Health and its members to Shield HealthCare," said Eric Morrow, Senior Director of Payor Solutions & Market Access . "This relationship advances our commitment to helping individuals receive the products, service and support they need to live confidently and independently."
Under the agreement, all eligible Astiva Health members may receive covered medical supplies through Shield HealthCare. Coverage varies by member and plan, and all orders must meet applicable benefit, eligibility and coverage requirements.
For information about eligibility or ordering, members can call Shield HealthCare at (800) 228-7150 or visit www.shieldhealthcare.com .
About Shield HealthCare Shield HealthCare is an industry leader in providing medical supplies to patients at home and managing their third-party insurance billing. Contracted payors include Medicare, state Medicaid programs, HMOs and private insurance plans.
About Astiva Health Astiva Health offers Medicare HMO and HMO C-SNP plans. Enrollment in Astiva Health depends on contract renewal.
